- id: hallway_motion_lights_on_when_dark
  alias: Hallway lights - motion on when dark
  description: Turn on hallway lights when motion is detected below 30 lux, using dim
    overnight and gentle morning levels, then turn them off after 5 minutes with no
    motion.
  mode: restart
  triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.hallway_motion
    to: "on"
    id: motion
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.hallway_illuminance
    below: 30
    id: became_dark
  conditions:
  - condition: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.hallway_illuminance
    below: 30
  - condition: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.hallway_motion
    state: "on"
  actions:
  - choose:
    - conditions:
      - condition: time
        after: "23:00:00"
        before: "06:30:00"
      sequence:
      - action: light.turn_on
        target:
          entity_id: light.hallway_hallway
        data:
          brightness_pct: 12
          color_temp_kelvin: 2202
          transition: 1
    - conditions:
      - condition: time
        after: "06:30:00"
        before: "09:30:00"
      sequence:
      - action: light.turn_on
        target:
          entity_id: light.hallway_hallway
        data:
          brightness_pct: 30
          color_temp_kelvin: 2400
          transition: 2
    default:
    - action: light.turn_on
      target:
        entity_id: light.hallway_hallway
      data:
        brightness_pct: 35
        color_temp_kelvin: 2700
        transition: 2
  - wait_for_trigger:
    - trigger: state
      entity_id: binary_sensor.hallway_motion
      to: "off"
      for:
        minutes: 5
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: light.hallway_hallway
    data:
      transition: 10
- id: hallway_lights_adjust_brightness_for_time
  alias: Hallway lights - adjust brightness for time
  description: Adjust hallway light brightness at time-band boundaries if the lights
    are already on.
  mode: single
  triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "23:00:00"
    id: overnight
  - trigger: time
    at: "06:30:00"
    id: morning
  - trigger: time
    at: "09:30:00"
    id: normal
  conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: light.hallway_hallway
    state: "on"
  actions:
  - choose:
    - conditions:
      - condition: trigger
        id: overnight
      sequence:
      - action: light.turn_on
        target:
          entity_id: light.hallway_hallway
        data:
          brightness_pct: 12
          color_temp_kelvin: 2202
          transition: 10
    - conditions:
      - condition: trigger
        id: morning
      sequence:
      - action: light.turn_on
        target:
          entity_id: light.hallway_hallway
        data:
          brightness_pct: 30
          color_temp_kelvin: 2400
          transition: 10
    - conditions:
      - condition: trigger
        id: normal
      sequence:
      - action: light.turn_on
        target:
          entity_id: light.hallway_hallway
        data:
          brightness_pct: 35
          color_temp_kelvin: 2700
          transition: 10
- id: living_room_lifx_on_when_dark_after_10
  alias: Kitchen lights - on when dark after 10am
  description: Turn on the kitchen light and softer lamp when it becomes dark after
    10am and before the 11:30pm shutoff.
  mode: single
  triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: sun.sun
    to: below_horizon
  - trigger: time
    at: "10:00:00"
  conditions:
  - condition: time
    after: "10:00:00"
    before: "23:30:00"
  - condition: state
    entity_id: sun.sun
    state: below_horizon
  actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.kitchen_kitchen_light
    data:
      brightness_pct: 60
      color_temp_kelvin: 2700
      transition: 5
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.bedroom_lamp
    data:
      brightness_pct: 30
      color_temp_kelvin: 2400
      transition: 5
- id: living_room_lifx_off_at_2330
  alias: Kitchen lights - off at 11:30pm
  description: Turn off the kitchen light and lamp every night at 11:30pm.
  mode: single
  triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "23:30:00"
  actions:
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id:
      - light.kitchen_kitchen_light
      - light.bedroom_lamp
    data:
      transition: 10
